guard: Jcode checkpoints preserve valid event brackets and reject unrelated source faults
why: Real managed seats were terminated by event-source checkpoint errors during tool calls. The controls drive the shipped journal reader, mapper and strict bracket validator.

mutations.name: leave interrupted tool observations open
mutations.expectRed: FAIL checkpoint during an open tool preserves valid event brackets

mutations.name: publish an end whose start was lost
mutations.find:
const missingStart = parts.some((part) => part?.type === "tool_result" &&
          typeof part.tool_use_id === "string" && part.tool_use_id.length > 0 && !remaining.delete(part.tool_use_id));
mutations.expectRed: FAIL a post-checkpoint tool result without its start is an explicit valid discontinuity

mutations.name: forget persisted open tool identities
mutations.expectRed: FAIL restart restores open tool observations without manufacturing a gap

mutations.name: accept another session snapshot
mutations.expectRed: FAIL a foreign session snapshot cannot authorize a reset

mutations.name: misclassify every cursor failure as a checkpoint
mutations.find:
if (!isMissing(error) && !(error instanceof JsonlFileResetError)) throw error;
        const fresh = await this.foldedSince();
mutations.expectRed: FAIL a valid snapshot cannot disguise a malformed cursor

mutations.name: fail when a second checkpoint races adoption
mutations.find:
if (!isMissing(error) && !(error instanceof JsonlFileResetError)) throw error;
          return null;
mutations.expectRed: FAIL a checkpoint racing the new-journal adoption remains recoverable

mutations.name: lose the typed truncation boundary
mutations.expectRed: FAIL checkpoint during an open tool preserves valid event brackets
